title: Now
intro: A snapshot of what I'm up to right now.
items: Studying for the MSc Data & AI for Finance (Albert School × Mines de Paris - PSL), as a work-study apprentice.
Working at Prosper Conseil as Digital Project Manager for automation and AI, building workflows and AI assistants for the firm's internal tools.
Building this portfolio, and Career Agent, a tool that drafts tailored CVs and cover letters.
Levelling up on data engineering, MLOps and the cloud (AWS Practitioner in progress).
Still taking on freelance web and data projects, and always open to interesting collaborations.
